caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object with a silver or grayish tone, oriented vertically on a light beige background. The object consists of a flat, rectangular strip that curves at the bottom to form a shallow, open, oval-shaped cup. At the top of the strip is a rounded end with a hole in the center, and the edges of the top are decorated with a series of evenly spaced, short lines forming a border. The strip features a patterned design: near the top and bottom are stars enclosed within wavy, scalloped shapes, and there is an additional raised star design in the central portion. A continuous wavy line runs along both long sides of the strip, framing the central decorations. The overall appearance is that of a handcrafted metal item, and the rendering is done with soft shading to show highlights and contours, creating a three-dimensional effect. The name "MABEL G. CLAFLIN - TAOS – N. M." is written in small script in the lower right corner.
title: Tin Candle Sconce
